messages:
alex: Quick question — what's the approved rollout path for the new ratecard (v3.1) SKUs? Need to confirm how we handle existing commits and grandfathering. cc @maria @deal-desk

maria: @alex short answer: commits are honored for 90 days after public rollout unless explicitly grandfathered. We need deal desk approval for any exceptions. See internal doc: https://go/redwood/ratecards/v3.1 :eyes:

sam: Who signs off on special pricing? Is it still >$50k -> deal-desk + finance, >$200k -> CRO + legal? Trying to plan the POC quote.

maria: Process unchanged. >$50k needs deal-desk + finance review; >$200k escalate to CRO + legal. For bespoke SLA or on-prem/private deployments add security review (sec-eng).

deal-desk-bot: NEW RATECARD DETECTED: v3.1. Automated checklist created. Required: pricing-exceptions form, grandfathering justification, MSA copy if mid-deal. Submit here: https://go/redwood/deal-desk/submit

alex: We have a mid-POC customer expecting the old SKU pricing. Can we request grandfathering? They signed LOI and expect offer within 48h.

jordan: @maria I'll queue a fast-track review. Need the signed LOI/MSA, expected commit (term + ARR), and exact SKUs. If marked fast-track we can aim for 48-72h turnaround. :thinking_face:

maria: Confirmed — if deal desk tags it as "fast-track" and all docs are attached we’ll prioritize. Provide: (1) signed MSA, (2) expected ARR and term, (3) list of SKUs + proposed discounted rates, (4) business justification for grandfathering.

sam: FYI v3.1 renames a few SKUs (internal quoting matrix update required). Example diff for quoting team:
```
- dedicated-xlarge -> $0.45/token
+ dedicated-xl     -> $0.44/token
```
Please don't send final offers until quoting matrix is synchronized.

alex: Got it. I'll hold external comms and attach LOI + SKU list to the deal-desk form now. Putting thread tag: #awaiting-deal-desk. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
